description: Source code for the PUSCH power control support class, implementing power control algorithms for uplink scheduling in a 5G NR context.

classes.name: pusch_power_controller
classes.description: Class managing PUSCH power control, including configuration reloading, PRB grid management, PHR handling, and TPC command computation.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reloads PUSCH power control configuration from UE cell configuration.

methods.name: update_pusch_pw_ctrl_state
methods.description: Updates the power control state for a specific slot and PRB count.

methods.name: handle_phr
methods.description: Processes a PHR report, updating path loss estimates and PHR data.

methods.name: adapt_pusch_prbs_to_phr
methods.description: Adjusts the number of PRBs for PUSCH based on latest PHR to prevent power issues.

methods.name: compute_tpc_command
methods.description: Calculates the TPC command for a given PUSCH slot based on SINR and power control state.
